summary: 3 NEW color-contrast errors (serious/WCAG 2 AA) on .agent-meta in AgentMatrix.astro; 3 pre-existing /start/ violations are out of scope for CLV-27.

findings.message: .agent-meta text in AgentMatrix.astro fails WCAG 2 AA contrast ratio. var(--color-text-subtle) at 9px font-size on the 'full pipeline' label of UI Reviewer/QA/Documenter cards. Fix: use a higher-contrast color variable, raise font-size, or restyle. Three target instances (children 3, 4, 5 of the Delivery .agent-list).
PRE-EXISTING (not caused by CLV-27): .footnote color-contrast and link-in-text-block violations on /cloverleaf/start/. Do NOT modify start.astro in this task — track separately.

Visual baselines captured (informational). /cloverleaf/ matched; /cloverleaf/guide/ dimension-mismatch (page grew due to AgentMatrix); /cloverleaf/start/ new-baseline; /cloverleaf/faq/ dimension-mismatch. baselines_pending=true.
